title: Extras
subtitle: Your local replays and a read-only look at BakkesMod.

replays.title: Replays
replays.emptyHint: Save a replay at the end of a match and it will show up here.

bakkes.eacNote: BakkesMod injects into the game, which Easy Anti-Cheat forbids: it only works when you launch without EAC (offline). This app only reads its folders and never starts or injects it.
